intro.text: The seon of King Eventeo of Teod, who calls the king his master.

items.text: Sarene assumed her father used Dio to talk with her through Ashe, though Eventeo had other seons as well, and Ashe once suggested Dio might know about Kiin's possible disinheritance, being close to the king. Eventeo sent Dio all the way to Arelon to reach the gyorn Hrathen.

appearance.text: A melon-sized ball of light with Aon Dio, meaning steadfast, glowing at its centre. He has a melodious voice.
